reason: I already pass a supermarket on my way home from work, so picking up a bag in the village is not saving me a trip. I would be paying $2 a bag to let someone I do not know choose my tomatoes.
objection: What if they bring the wrong item, the wrong size or a rotten tomato, and I find out only when I am home with cash already paid? Nothing says who fixes it.
would_change_my_mind: A neighbour I know running it, plus a promise in writing that they replace or refund anything wrong or bad at pickup, and I could check the bag and receipt before paying.
